SENS-DECLARED.title: Declared baseline: the level a person entered for the zone in the facility profile, carried over unchanged. This is a manual input, not an automated assessment; no derivation methodology exists yet (D1)

SENS-MISSING.title: No declared level: sensitivity is undetermined. Missing information is never treated as low sensitivity

ASSET-REVIEW.title: The zone holds an asset whose data classification is higher than the zone level: review prompt only, the level is not changed
ASSET-REVIEW.note: Data classification and zone sensitivity are different scales (decision D1).

CSCC-SCOPE.title: Critical-system controls follow an asset’s critical-system classification, not the sensitivity of the zone it is in. SAWN records the status per asset and derives no zone requirement from it
CSCC-SCOPE.ref: NCA CSCC-1:2019 (not available locally; cited for scope only)

AREA-MAP.title: Area designation from the zone level: 1–3 Controlled, 4 Limited, 5 Exclusion
AREA-MAP.ref: Area names: NIST SP 800-116 Rev. 1 (2018), Section 5: Controlled, Limited and Exclusion areas. The level boundaries are SAWN’s.

AUTH-FACTORS.title: Authentication factors at entry: Controlled 1, Limited 2, Exclusion 3
AUTH-FACTORS.ref: NIST SP 800-116 Rev. 1 (2018), Section 5: Controlled, Limited and Exclusion areas

READER-LINK.title: Reader link: level 4–5 OSDP Secure Channel, level 3 OSDP, level 1–2 any

ENTRY-CAMERA.title: A camera covers each entrance at level 3 and above
ENTRY-CAMERA.ref: NCA ECC-1:2018 control 2-14 (physical security); text matched by control number in the local Arabic copy, 2-14-3-2 (entry and exit records and monitoring, CCTV). The level threshold is SAWN’s.

CARD-TECH.title: No 125 kHz proximity cards at any entrance

VISITOR-SCOPE.title: Visitor passes exclude zones at level 4 and above

ACCESS-REVIEW.title: Access to a zone is reviewed every 90 days at level 4–5 and yearly otherwise

NA-KIND.title: Entrance access-control requirements do not apply to airspace and SAWN-system zones

FIND-SEV.title: Weakness severity follows the zone level: 5 critical, 4 high, 3 medium, 1–2 low

PRIO-1.title: Operational priority = incident severity, +1 at zone level 5, +0.5 at level 4, −0.5 when detection confidence is below 60 %. Sensitivity never confirms an event or makes every event critical

GATE-DEVICES.title: Wireless device categories restricted at a gate follow the destination zone level (gate policy)

ADJ-BELOW-PROPOSAL.title: An adjusted level below the declared baseline needs an acknowledged reason at approval

ADJ-BELOW-ACTIVE.title: A level below the active policy needs an acknowledged reason at approval

PRIORITY-DOWN.title: A change that lowers the priority new incidents would get needs an acknowledged reason at approval

INCOMPLETE.title: Approving a zone with missing information needs an acknowledged reason

NO-LEVEL.title: Every zone needs a sensitivity level before the policy can be approved

REQ-BELOW-RULE.title: A protection requirement set below what the zone level requires is an exception and needs a recorded exception by an authorized role

ACCEPT-L5.title: A weakness in a level-5 zone cannot be accepted

ACCEPT-L4-30.title: A weakness in a level-4 zone can be accepted for at most 30 days

ACCEPT-MAX-90.title: A weakness can be accepted for at most 90 days
